strings.zh: 这里是４８号道路{NEWLINE}北　度假区
strings.en: Rt. 48{NEWLINE}North to Resort Zone
strings.notes: US 'North to Safari Zone' → hack's 度假区 Resort Zone

strings.zh: 你好,再往前走一小段路{NEWLINE}就能到达度假区了。{CLEAR}祝您在度假区享受一段{CLEAR}美好快乐的时光。
strings.en: Hello! Just a little farther and you’ll{NEWLINE}reach the Resort Zone. I hope you{CLEAR}have a wonderful, happy time there.

strings.zh: 艾路雷朵『Gaaaa——la！
strings.en: Gallade: Gaaaa-la!

strings.zh: 艾路雷朵看起来很着急,{NEWLINE}似乎是在表达什么。
strings.en: Gallade looks anxious. It seems{NEWLINE}to be trying to tell you something.

strings.zh: 你是饿了吗？
strings.en: Are you hungry?

strings.zh: 卷耳兔『Buu……{SCROLL}卷耳兔很虚弱。
strings.en: Buneary: Buu...{SCROLL}Buneary is very weak.

strings.zh: 你的朋友遇到麻烦了？
strings.en: Is your friend in trouble?

strings.zh: 跟我没关系,别找我
strings.en: Not my problem

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『看你这么着急的样子,{NEWLINE}是因为找不到食物饿了吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You look so anxious. Are you{NEWLINE}hungry because you can’t find food?

strings.zh: 艾路雷朵『Gaaaa——la！{SCROLL}艾路雷朵摇了摇头。
strings.en: Gallade: Gaaaa-la!{SCROLL}Gallade shook its head.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我看你后面那只卷耳兔{NEWLINE}有点虚弱啊,{CLEAR}是受伤了吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: That Buneary behind you{NEWLINE}looks kind of weak. Is it hurt?

strings.zh: 艾路雷朵『Gaaaa——la！{SCROLL}艾路雷朵点了点头。
strings.en: Gallade: Gaaaa-la!{SCROLL}Gallade nodded.

strings.zh: 我这里有好伤药
strings.en: I’ve got a Super Potion

strings.zh: 我这里有树果汁
strings.en: I’ve got Berry Juice

strings.zh: 你并没有好伤药！
strings.en: You don’t have a Super Potion!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这是治疗用的好伤药,{NEWLINE}只要喷一下就能让伤势恢复,{CLEAR}快给卷耳兔试试吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: This Super Potion treats{NEWLINE}injuries. One spray and it heals{CLEAR}wounds. Try it on Buneary, quick!

strings.zh: 艾路雷朵『Gaaaa——la！{SCROLL}艾路雷朵看了看好伤药,{NEWLINE}似乎并不知道怎么用。
strings.en: Gallade: Gaaaa-la!{SCROLL}Gallade looked at the Super Potion. It{NEWLINE}doesn’t seem to know how to use it.

strings.zh: 你并没有树果汁！
strings.en: You don’t have any Berry Juice!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这是很有营养的树果汁,{NEWLINE}你喂一些给卷耳兔试试。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: This Berry Juice{NEWLINE}is really nutritious. Try{CLEAR}feeding some to Buneary.

strings.zh: 艾路雷朵『Gaaaa——la！{SCROLL}艾路雷朵接过了树果汁。
strings.en: Gallade: Gaaaa-la!{SCROLL}Gallade took the Berry Juice.

strings.zh: 艾路雷朵给卷耳兔喂了一些树果汁。
strings.en: Gallade fed Buneary some Berry Juice.

strings.zh: 卷耳兔『Buuuu——nea！{SCROLL}卷耳兔恢复了精神！
strings.en: Buneary: Buuuu-nea!{SCROLL}Buneary perked up!

strings.zh: 卷耳兔『Buuuu——nea！
strings.en: Buneary: Buuuu-nea!

strings.zh: 艾路雷朵『Gaaaa——la！{SCROLL}艾路雷朵向你点头致意。
strings.en: Gallade: Gaaaa-la!{SCROLL}Gallade nodded to you in thanks.

strings.zh: 呼……呼……{NEWLINE}再往前走一点就能到度假区了,{CLEAR}可把我给累死了。
strings.en: Huff... huff... Just a little farther to{NEWLINE}the Resort Zone. I’m totally worn out.
